achievements.name: First Star
achievements.detail: Buy a Star from Toadette during a board party.

achievements.name: Party Winner
achievements.detail: End a board with more Stars than every other player.

achievements.name: Speed Hockey
achievements.detail: Win a game of Speed Hockey.

achievements.name: Solo Minigame
achievements.detail: Win a one-versus-three minigame from the single-player side.

achievements.name: Team Minigame
achievements.detail: Win a two-versus-two minigame with your partner.

achievements.name: Boo Steal
achievements.detail: Pay a Boo to take coins or a Star from another player.

achievements.name: Shop Item
achievements.detail: Buy an item from a shop on the board and use it on a turn.

achievements.name: Bonus Star
achievements.detail: Receive a Bonus Star when the party results are announced.

achievements.name: Tropical Island
achievements.detail: Finish a party on Yoshi's Tropical Island.

achievements.name: Minigame Mountain
achievements.detail: Win a minigame selected from the Mt. Minigames list.

achievements.name: Final Five
achievements.detail: Win the party after the final five turns have started.

achievements.name: Every Board
achievements.detail: Win a party on each of the five classic boards.
